source.terrain: Mapzen/AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium), zoom 12, composite of SRTM, NED, and national DEMs; highest ground elevation per cell; England (EGLL): Environment Agency LIDAR Composite first-return DSM 1 m (WCS), highest surface per cell
source.runways: OurAirports runways.csv (public domain), longest non-closed runway; thresholds as runway ends
source.other_obstacles: OpenStreetMap tall structures with a height tag (Overpass API), ODbL, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors
source.frame: s metres along the runway heading from the start of the take-off roll (threshold), y metres to the right of the extended centreline, elevations metres above mean sea level
source.limitation: Derived from public terrain and obstacle data, not an AIP Type A obstacle chart; straight departure along the runway heading; obstacle heights from OSM/DOF where tagged. Bare-earth tiles omit untagged trees and buildings and radar surface models (SRTM, EU-DEM) read the highest object of a cell low; the Environment Agency first-return DSM (England) holds no object built since its 2016-2022 surveys and reads canopy low. No survey here can certify a clearance (completeness_allowance_m on every direction): the verdicts are violated or undetermined until a licensed current obstacle survey is loaded.

Terrain: Mapzen/AWS Terrain Tiles with the attributions of https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md (EU-DEM Copernicus, USGS 3DEP/SRTM/GMTED2010, Geoscience Australia, INEGI, Austrian DGM, Environment Agency UK and others). FAA DOF and OurAirports are public domain. See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

directions.terrain_source: EA LIDAR Composite first-return DSM 1 m [vertical accuracy of the individual surveys +-0.15 m RMSE (EA metadata), LE90 0.35 m for a difference, quantisation 0.1 m (symmetric); one-sided: mobile objects 7.01 m (14 CFR 77.9(c) railroad); completeness 100 m (canopy and objects built since the survey not bounded); cell maxima over the full 250 m x 30 m cell padded by 3 m; Terrarium tiles only as the fallback of a cell without DSM data; survey vintage 2016-2022, objects built since are in the data only if OSM-tagged]
